nodes.label: Receive pre-analysed video data

outputs.name: video_data
outputs.description: Pre-analysed video data from the parent workflow: transcript, key moments/sections, visual analysis, and metadata

requirement_evidence: triggered by a parent workflow that provides pre-analysed video data (transcript, key moments/sections, visual analysis, and metadata)
nodes.rationale: Entry point: the sub-workflow is invoked by a parent workflow with pre-analysed video data. Deterministic external IO, type=code.

nodes.label: Extract and structure snippets and context

inputs.name: video_data
inputs.description: Pre-analysed video data from the parent workflow

outputs.name: video_context
outputs.description: Structured key snippets, B-roll timestamps/clips, video overview, and context ready for AI processing

requirement_evidence: extract and structure the key snippets, B-roll timestamps, and video context ready for AI processing
nodes.rationale: Deterministic restructuring of the incoming data into a prepared context object; the prompt-field preparation for the AI agent is part of the same data-preparation contract, type=code.

nodes.label: Generate 3 unique short-form concepts

inputs.name: video_context
inputs.description: Prepared transcript, key moments, and video overview

outputs.name: concepts
outputs.description: Exactly 3 unique short-form concepts, each with hook, body structure, CTA, full avatar script, and lead magnet deliverable prompt

requirement_evidence: use a language model-powered AI agent to analyse the transcript, key moments, and video overview and generate 3 unique short-form concepts per video
using structured output parsing to guarantee clean JSON
nodes.rationale: Open-ended concept ideation constrained by structured output parsing, type=semantic. Produces the 3 concepts consumed by the loop.

nodes.label: Loop over concepts

inputs.name: concepts
inputs.description: The 3 generated concepts

outputs.name: current_concept
outputs.description: The concept currently being produced in the pipeline

requirement_evidence: loop through each concept and run the full production pipeline in parallel for each one
nodes.rationale: Deterministic iteration control over the 3 concepts. Termination: all 3 concepts processed; max_iterations = 3 (<= 20). The loop body fans out into parallel production lanes (avatar, B-roll, lead magnet) and re-enters via the tracker-log back edge.

nodes.label: Generate avatar video

inputs.name: current_concept
inputs.description: Concept whose full avatar script is rendered

outputs.name: avatar_video_url
outputs.description: URL of the completed vertical (1080x1920) AI avatar video

requirement_evidence: send each concept's full script to an avatar video generation service to generate a vertical (1080×1920) AI avatar video, poll the status endpoint until rendering is complete, and capture the avatar video URL
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external generation whose internal polling loop terminates when status == completed (max_iterations <= 20); the captured URL is the single output contract, so the submit/poll/capture sub-steps are folded into this node.

nodes.label: Determine needed B-roll

inputs.name: current_concept
inputs.description: Concept used to decide which B-roll visuals are needed

inputs.name: video_context
inputs.description: Available B-roll timestamps/clips from the source video

outputs.name: broll_plan
outputs.description: Planned B-roll prompts and clip specifications

requirement_evidence: determine what B-roll is needed via an AI Video Director and send prompts to a video generation service to generate 2-second vertical clips at 24fps and 720p
nodes.rationale: Open-ended creative direction of which B-roll is required, based on the concept and the available source-video B-roll material, type=semantic. Runs while the avatar renders (parallel lane).

nodes.label: Generate and aggregate B-roll clips

inputs.name: broll_plan
inputs.description: Prompts and specs for the B-roll clips

outputs.name: broll_clips
outputs.description: Aggregated 2-second vertical B-roll clips at 24fps and 720p

requirement_evidence: with multiple clips generated and aggregated
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external generation of multiple clips and their aggregation into one collection, type=code.

nodes.label: Create beat-by-beat storyboard

inputs.name: current_concept
inputs.description: Concept with title, type, and full script

inputs.name: avatar_video_url
inputs.description: Completed avatar video used to fix the total duration

inputs.name: broll_clips
inputs.description: Aggregated B-roll clips selectable by the director

outputs.name: storyboard
outputs.description: Beat-by-beat storyboard with layout types (avatar full-frame, split-screen, picture-in-picture), transition effects, and timing

requirement_evidence: use a language model-powered AI Video Director to create a beat-by-beat storyboard with dynamic layout transitions
specifying layout types (avatar full-frame for hooks/CTAs, split-screen for demos, picture-in-picture overlays for focus moments), transition effects, and timing
nodes.rationale: Open-ended direction of a timed storyboard constrained by structured output, type=semantic. Consumes the avatar URL and the aggregated B-roll.

nodes.label: Build render payload

inputs.name: storyboard
inputs.description: Storyboard with beats, layouts, and transitions

inputs.name: avatar_video_url
inputs.description: Avatar video to assemble

inputs.name: broll_clips
inputs.description: B-roll clips to assemble

outputs.name: render_payload
outputs.description: 1080x1920 composition payload assembling avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects

requirement_evidence: convert the storyboard into a render payload assembling avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects into a single 1080×1920 composition
nodes.rationale: Deterministic conversion of the storyboard into a render payload that assembles the avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects, type=code.

nodes.label: Render final video and download

inputs.name: render_payload
inputs.description: Composition payload to render

requirement_evidence: send the render to a rendering service, poll until complete, and download it
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external render whose internal polling loop terminates when status == succeeded (max_iterations <= 20), then downloads the file; the submit/poll/download sub-steps are folded into this node.

nodes.label: Upload video to Google Drive and share

inputs.name: rendered_video
inputs.description: Finished video to upload

outputs.name: drive_url
outputs.description: Google Drive link of the uploaded and shared video

requirement_evidence: upload the finished video to Google Drive and share it
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external upload/share, type=code; the requirement declares sharing alongside upload, so both are captured in this step. The drive link is consumed by the copywriter and the tracker.

nodes.label: Generate platform-optimised copy

inputs.name: current_concept
inputs.description: Concept providing title, type, description, CTA, and script

inputs.name: drive_url
inputs.description: Drive link of the finished video

outputs.name: social_copy
outputs.description: Platform-optimised titles, descriptions, hashtags, and captions for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

requirement_evidence: use a language model-powered Social Media Copywriter to generate platform-optimised titles, descriptions, hashtags, and captions for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

nodes.label: Create lead magnet document

inputs.name: current_concept
inputs.description: Concept whose CTA promise defines the lead magnet deliverable

outputs.name: lead_magnet_markdown
outputs.description: Downloadable lead magnet document content (guide, template, checklist, etc.) in Markdown

requirement_evidence: use a language model-powered Document Generator to create a downloadable lead magnet (actionable guide, template, checklist, etc.) based on the CTA promise from each concept
nodes.rationale: Open-ended document generation per concept (each concept carries a lead magnet deliverable prompt), type=semantic. Runs in parallel with the video production lanes.

nodes.label: Convert lead magnet to HTML

inputs.name: lead_magnet_markdown
inputs.description: Markdown document content to convert

requirement_evidence: convert it to HTML
nodes.rationale: Deterministic conversion of the generated Markdown into HTML, a distinct intermediate artifact with its own output contract, type=code.

nodes.label: Create and share Google Doc

inputs.name: lead_magnet_html
inputs.description: HTML content to upload as a Google Doc

outputs.name: magnet_url
outputs.description: Publicly shared Google Doc link of the lead magnet

requirement_evidence: upload it as a Google Doc, share it publicly
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external actions uploading the HTML as a Google Doc and sharing it publicly; the single output contract is the public link (magnet_url), so the two external sub-actions form one publish node, type=code.

nodes.label: Log everything to Google Sheets tracker

inputs.name: social_copy
inputs.description: Platform copy to record

inputs.name: drive_url
inputs.description: Video drive link to record

inputs.name: magnet_url
inputs.description: Lead magnet doc link to record

outputs.name: tracker_row
outputs.description: Full tracking row for the produced short

requirement_evidence: log everything to a Google Sheets tracker
link it in the tracker sheet
nodes.rationale: Deterministic external write that aggregates the per-concept artifacts into the tracker (both native appends write to the same tracker with the same output contract). Its back edge re-enters the loop for the next concept.

nodes.label: Complete source video processing
native_evidence: Loop Through Concepts (loop exit after the last concept)
requirement_evidence: for each source video, 3 unique shorts are generated
a finished rendered vertical video (1080×1920 MP4) uploaded to Google Drive
nodes.rationale: Loop-exit terminal: after all 3 concepts have been processed, the per-video processing completes. All per-concept visible outcomes (video in Drive, copy, lead magnet doc, tracker rows) are delivered inside the loop. No CFG out-edges.

cfg_edges.rationale: Incoming video data is structured for AI processing.
The 3 concepts enter the loop control.
Loop body entry for the avatar generation lane.
Loop body entry for the B-roll planning lane (parallel to avatar generation).
Loop body entry for the lead magnet document lane (parallel).
Completed avatar video feeds the storyboard direction.
B-roll plan is sent to the video generation service.
Aggregated B-roll clips feed the storyboard direction.
Storyboard is converted into the render payload.
Payload is sent for rendering and the output is downloaded.
Finished video is uploaded and shared on Google Drive.
Drive link and concept feed the social copy generation.
Platform copy is logged to the tracker.
Generated document is converted to HTML.
HTML is uploaded as a Google Doc and shared publicly.
Lead magnet link is logged to the tracker.
Back edge: after logging, the loop proceeds to the next concept.
Loop exit: processing completes once all concepts are done; n17 is the terminal.

dfg_edges.rationale: Pre-analysed data is structured.
Prepared context drives concept generation.
Concepts enter the loop.
Concept script feeds avatar generation.
Concept feeds B-roll planning.
B-roll planning uses the source video's available B-roll material.
Planned prompts drive B-roll generation.
Aggregated clips feed the storyboard.
Avatar video URL fixes the storyboard duration.
Concept info feeds the storyboard direction.
Storyboard is assembled into the render payload.
The payload assembles the avatar video.
The payload assembles the B-roll clips.
Payload is rendered and downloaded.
Finished video is uploaded to Drive.
Drive link is included in the copy context.
Concept details feed copy generation.
Concept CTA promise feeds lead magnet generation.
Markdown document is converted to HTML.
HTML content is uploaded as a Google Doc.
Lead magnet link is logged in the tracker.
Platform copy is logged in the tracker.
Video drive link is logged in the tracker.

notes: 共识 Gold（17 节点、单入口 n1、单终止 n17 循环退出）：触发 → 结构化 → 概念生成(semantic) → 概念循环 → 并行车道（avatar 折叠生成 / B-roll 规划 semantic + 生成聚合 / lead magnet 生成 semantic + HTML 转换 + 创建共享 doc）→ storyboard semantic → render payload → 渲染下载折叠 → Drive 上传共享 → 社媒文案 semantic → 单一 tracker 写入（回边 n16→n4）→ 循环退出终止 n17。轮询折叠进节点契约（status==completed/succeeded，max_iterations<=20）；循环终止条件 all 3 concepts processed（max_iterations=3）。混合任务类型边：n3/n6/n8/n12/n13(semantic)→code。补全三条漏画 DFG 边（n2→n6、n5→n9、n7→n9）。排除未声明实现：头像/语音 ID、特效库内容、品牌示例文案、文件夹 ID、提示词文本等。
